metadata.title: HIV-1 gp120-CD4-CCR5 Binding Hotspots and Pharmacophore Models
metadata.author: Jonathan Retting

numbering.gp120_chain_G: Author numbering from isolate 92UG037.8. HXB2 equivalents provided per-residue.
numbering.cd4_chain_A: PDB residue N = UniProt P01730 residue N+25

binding_hotspots.known_role: N-terminal contact with gp120 bridging sheet; adjacent to sulfated Tyr10/Tyr14
Not a primary contact site in current literature
ECL2 contact surface (maraviroc allosteric target region)
ECL3 region — not extensively characterized for HIV contact
ECL3 — not extensively characterized for HIV contact
V1/V2 shielding region — not typically targeted
Bridging sheet connecting CD4-induced conformation to CCR5 binding
gp41 conformational relay — not a current drug target

pharmacophore_targets.name: gp120 Conformational Relay
pharmacophore_targets.proposed_mechanism: Occupancy prevents conformational signal from gp120 binding event reaching gp41 fusion machinery

pharmacophore_targets.name: CCR5 ECL2 (Maraviroc Region)
pharmacophore_targets.proposed_mechanism: Allosteric inhibition of gp120 coreceptor binding via ECL2 pocket occupancy

pharmacophore_targets.name: gp120 V3 Loop
pharmacophore_targets.proposed_mechanism: Competitive inhibition of V3 loop insertion into CCR5 chemokine-binding pocket

pharmacophore_targets.name: CCR5 ECL3
pharmacophore_targets.proposed_mechanism: Disruption of ECL3/TM6-7 contact surface — possible allosteric modulation of gp120 engagement

pymol_selections.all_hotspots: select hotspots, (chain A and resi 13+15+27+66) or (chain B and resi 7+29+109+174+184+194+251+255+258+276) or (chain G and resi 127+282+323+326+418+465+467+472)
pymol_selections.novel_hotspots: select novel, (chain B and resi 109+251+255+258+276) or (chain G and resi 127+465+467+472)
pymol_selections.known_hotspots: select known, (chain A and resi 13+15+27+66) or (chain B and resi 7+29+174+184+194) or (chain G and resi 282+323+326+418)
pymol_selections.gp120_gp41_relay: select gp41_relay, chain G and resi 465-472
pymol_selections.ccr5_ecl2: select ecl2, chain B and resi 174+184+194
pymol_selections.gp120_v3: select v3_loop, chain G and resi 323+326
pymol_selections.ccr5_ecl3: select ecl3, chain B and resi 251+255+258+276

visualization.notes: Load PDB 6MEO first. Pharmacophore feature centers can be loaded as pseudoatoms in PyMOL or markers in ChimeraX.

existing_drugs.name: Enfuvirtide (Fuzeon)
existing_drugs.mechanism: Fusion inhibitor; blocks six-helix bundle formation

existing_drugs.name: Ibalizumab (Trogarzo)
existing_drugs.mechanism: Post-attachment inhibitor; binds CD4 D2, blocks conformational change

existing_drugs.name: Fostemsavir / BMS-626529 (Rukobia)
existing_drugs.mechanism: Binds gp120 near beta20-beta21 element; blocks CD4 attachment
existing_drugs.note: Directly validates G:418/HXB2-I423 as a druggable site

sequence_conservation.note: Computed from 981 NCBI HIV-1 gp120 sequences pairwise-aligned to HXB2 (Biopython). Script: compute_entropy_proper.py
